versions.author: designer
versions.summary:
Two gold counters: the Hive pays for gold you hold at End of Turn, the Carnival pays for gold you spend each turn.
The big turns come from saving up and then spending it all at once, or keeping both numbers level.

versions.author: reviser
versions.summary:
Every unit now prints its town (Hive, Carnival or Road), so the town buffs can be read.
Lord Fennimore, Tithonus and Madame Cigale say exactly which numbers and which gold they count; Comb Guard is a 2/3 to win early fights.

stop_reason: 3 of 3 reviewers said it's in a good spot
